_doc: Text roles of the shell for the exact token calculation of gate A2 (tests/visual/test_contrast_tokens.py).
fg: <palette>.<colour token> (palette colors = the current appearance, darkColors = always dark). opacity: factors applied to the
text alpha (numbers or token paths such as lock.focusRingOpacity). backdrop: material (tint at 1 - t*(1-tintAlphaMin) over a

flat wallpaper colour, with and without a fill overlay), window (an opaque app window: windowBackground and sidebarFill, bare and under a rimmed capsule's fill and the search field's; window-pane: the same without the field), accent (solid accent), selection (solid selection: the light accent in both appearances), rename-field

(colors.fieldFill at desktopIcon.renameFillOpacity over the wallpaper), weather-sky (the Weather widget's opaque day, night and grey gradients, widget.weatherSky*, both ends of each), bar-light-tone and bar-dark-tone (the adaptive menu bar: the wallpaper itself, for the wallpaper colours the tone can be chosen for, see test_contrast_tokens.py), desktop-label (shadow colour at desktopIcon.labelShadowOpacity over the wallpaper: conservative core of
the drop shadow), lock (lock screen: dark shadow-colour scrim at lock.dimOpacity over the blurred wallpaper, the same in both appearances and at
every transparency), lock-field (lock + the dark password field fill at lock.fieldFillOpacity), lock-avatar (lock + the light avatar disc at
lock.avatarFillOpacity), lock-submit (lock-field + the return arrow disc: text colour at material.highlightOpacity, x2 when hovered),
lock-selection (the opaque dark-palette accent band of a selection in the lock's password field).
kind: text >= 4.5, large|icon >= 3.0. exempt: reason, the role is listed but not asserted (a disabled control, or a
surface outside the A2 scope that is tracked as a known limitation in the module spec, docs/specs/<module>.md).
sites: where the role is used in QML. A file x class count is cross-checked against shell/ and ui/Grassfield/ by a structural scan
(tests/visual/qml_scan.py), so a new use without a role fails. classes: secondary (any read of textSecondary: palette alias, colors["textSecondary"]),
danger (any read of the danger colour, text or graphic), alpha (a colour derived from a text token: withAlpha, Qt.alpha/darker/lighter/tint/rgba),
dynamic (a palette read with a computed key), opacity (a Text-like item or text component whose own or an ancestor's opacity is a literal below 1),
opacity-dynamic (the same with a computed value: a fade, drag ghost or disabled state; the steady state cannot be read from the source).
Inside shell/security/ every palette read counts (root.colors.x, colors.x, aliases, Tokens.colorDark.x): primary (text, accentText, fieldText
outside a derived colour) and backdrop (any other token: scrim, fill, ring, shadow), listed under the role whose rendering they are part of.

roles.id: text on material
secondary on material
danger text on material
danger graphic on material
switcher app name on material
accent text on accent
desktop label (white on opaque shadow core: ceiling)
menu bar text and glyphs, light foreground (bare bar over a dark wallpaper)
menu bar text and glyphs, dark foreground (bare bar over a light wallpaper)
desktop label, dark foreground (over a light wallpaper: the menu bar's rule, ADR-0039 step 25)
desktop label error (opaque shadow core: ceiling)
rename field text

Weather widget text and glyphs on its sky (ADR-0045 OC-14: the day, night and grey gradients of widget.weatherSky*, the grey one also the neutral sky of an unavailable report; the dark palette's text in both appearances, Weather.qml `ink`)
apps label, chip and field text
apps selected chip text
selection text on selection
text during a fade, crossfade or swipe (steady state opacity 1)
roles.exempt: opacity only animates the show/hide, page crossfade, hover reveal or swipe of the surface and is 1 once it is shown; the rendered steady state is measured by contrast.sh

roles.id: lock text on the scrim (date, clock, the user's message, name, error and notice lines; the scrim's text bands at lock.dimOpacity, the clear band between them holds no text, ADR-0040 step 4a; the idle dim carried under them while they fade in, step 5)
screen saver date and time over the dimmed wallpaper (ADR-0032: saver.wallpaperDimOpacity is lock.dimOpacity; the clock alone is the same text at saver.clockOnlyOpacity on black, far above 4.5:1)
lock avatar initials on the disc
lock password placeholder
lock typed dots and caret
lock return arrow (rest and hover)
lock password field focus ring
roles.note: drawn only by the SDDM greeter (packaging/sddm/theme/Main.qml, border at lockFocusRingOpacity), outside the scanned QML trees; the shell lock draws no ring since UI audit 2026-11-05 U23

roles.id: lock password selection (dots on the accent band)
lock password selection band against the field
idle dim layer (no text)
roles.exempt: the idle dim fades the session to the shadow colour for the last seconds before the lock and draws no text of its own

roles.id: menu bar of an output that is not the active one, light foreground (dimmed, macOS)
menu bar of an output that is not the active one, dark foreground (dimmed, macOS)
disabled text
roles.exempt: disabled or inactive component: exempt from WCAG 1.4.3

roles.id: disabled text in the text colour
roles.exempt: disabled or inactive component: exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 (a menu row, the tiling popover's disabled layouts and rows)

roles.id: inline pop-up disc (text colour at the disc opacity)
roles.exempt: the background of the pop-up's two-chevron glyph, which is drawn in the full text colour; the control is named by its value text (docs/specs/settings.md, macOS 27 pop-up in a row)

roles.id: stepped slider stops (text colour at the stop opacity)
roles.exempt: decoration under a stepped slider's track, as macOS 27 draws it (183 on 247): the knob's position and the slider's accessible value give the stop; its contrast is listed, not asserted

roles.id: segmented control hairline (text colour at the divider opacity)
roles.exempt: decoration between two unselected tabs, as macOS 27 draws it (181 on 236): each tab's label and the control's accessible value tell them apart; its contrast is listed, not asserted

roles.id: scroll bar thumb (text colour at the thumb opacity)
roles.exempt: overlay scroll bar thumb: a redundant, transient position indicator (the view also scrolls by wheel, keys and touch); its contrast is listed, not asserted

roles.id: a window's toolbar title while the window is not key (text colour at the inactive opacity)
roles.exempt: disabled or inactive component: exempt from WCAG 1.4.3; macOS 27 dims an inactive window's toolbar title to 1.98:1 (light, black 0.28) and 2.73:1 (dark, white 0.32), measured on its release captures (ADR-0039 step 17); the key window's title is 'text on an app window'

roles.id: a toolbar glyph on an app window (text colour at control.toolGlyphOpacity)
roles._sites_note: ui/Grassfield/Ui/ToolButton.qml (glyphColor): its tint is a property, not a text-token read, so the structural scan counts no site there

roles.id: neutral selection of an item on glass (the hover ink at the selection opacity)
roles.exempt: the current tile of the switcher and of a stack's grid, an Overview minimized window under the pointer or the keys, the tiling suggestions' window: one role since ADR-0039 step 12 (G6), at macOS 27's own value (its App Switcher: black at 0.25, 1.8:1 on its glass), under the 3:1 a state indicator should reach, as macOS draws it; the keys' current item also carries the focus ring (step 7); the text on it is covered by 'text on material', whose backdrop holds the stronger fill overlay; listed, not asserted, and tracked in docs/specs/tiling.md Known limitations

roles.id: clipboard page border in Search (text colour at the fill opacity)
roles.exempt: decoration: the hairline round the clipboard preview's page in Search; the page's own text carries the content and has its role; its contrast is listed, not asserted

roles.id: secondary text on an app window, its sidebar and their rimmed capsules
text and glyphs in the accent colour on an app window
text and glyphs in the accent colour on material
roles.exempt: accent-coloured text on glass over any wallpaper: no accent holds 4.5:1 at the worst wallpaper and transparency, the Grassfield green itself 2.36:1 (macOS draws such text on vibrancy too); every accent's ink keeps at least 2.2:1 there, no accent worse than the others (test_accent_ink_on_glass_is_no_worse_than_the_other_accents)
